RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

An all-male panel at a public broadcaster raises legitimate procedural questions and increases the risk of unconscious or affinity bias, especially given your longer tenure and leadership background. However, specific digital expertise may also have been an authentic, decisive requirement for the position. 

Do not level direct accusations immediately. First, send a polite follow-up requesting your written feedback, and check your organization’s hiring guidelines regarding panel diversity. If the response is evasive, fails to justify how criteria were weighted, or shows that panel composition breached diversity policies, consult your staff union or an employment specialist to evaluate raising a formal grievance.
